solutionSql:
SELECT d.id, d.name
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM shipments AS s
  WHERE s.driver_id = d.id
    AND s.status = 'delivered'
    AND s.route_id IN (1, 2)
)
ORDER BY d.id;

ambiguities.phrase: carries at least one shipment with status delivered
ambiguities.alternativeReading: A shipment_events row with status 'delivered' for a shipment the driver carries. Measured here: the same four drivers.

notes: Each of the four drivers has a delivered route 1 or 2 shipment. The event-based alternative returns the same four drivers.
